summary: Codifying the DSD-onset extractor (scripts/extract_dsd_onset.py) surfaced that the cross-engine §5 headline and the §4 onset-trend endpoints depend on WHICH reference-free DSD criterion is used. The proper two-part criterion (short<=n+1 AND b1=min(gs_lognorm)>1.5 -- the saturation-record definition) differs sharply from the b1>1.5-alone criterion that produced the published cross-engine gap. b1-alone over-fires on uniformly-reduced sub-fatigue bases (min(gs)>1.5 but the profile has NOT collapsed: short=2n, not <=n+1) -- the same over-firing class as the gs[0]<3.5 proxy bug caught earlier this session.

criteria.b1_only: min(gs_lognorm) > 1.5  (necessary but NOT sufficient; over-fires at small n / sub-fatigue q)
criteria.two_part_proper: short = #{i: gs_lognorm_i < 2.888} <= n+1  AND  min(gs_lognorm) > 1.5  (canonical DSD; profile collapsed to the dense sublattice)

section3_dimension_onset_spike.why: tab:dimonset / Fig 1 use the `advantage` field (bkz_dln - sdbkz_dln), no DSD flag. n=71-73 spike already reference-robust under 3 references. Solid.

The 'gap grows with dimension' claim survives on the reproducible points (gap 1% -> 18% -> 21% over n=79->89->101).

section5_beta40_cross_engine_gap.verdict: NOT REAL under the proper criterion -- the published gap is a b1-only artifact
section5_beta40_cross_engine_gap.two_part_onset: ~196-211 for BOTH SD and BKZ on both engines -- NO gap
section5_beta40_cross_engine_gap.interpretation: At q137 the b1-fired seeds are uniformly reduced (head q-vectors killed, short=2n) -- NOT dense-sublattice discovery. There IS a real SD-vs-BKZ difference there (SD drives min-GS above the secret floor more often: 14 vs 4) but it is aggressive reduction, not DSD. True DSD onset at beta=40 shows no SD-vs-BKZ gap.
section5_beta40_cross_engine_gap.history: This RESTORES the original g6k_dsd_qsweep_n89_beta40_saturation record's conclusion ('gap-regime and sieve-meaningful-beta do not overlap at n=89 -- regime-constrained'). That record was marked 'superseded/premature' by g6k_dsd_onset_n89_beta40, which switched to the b1-only criterion at q137 -- the supersede was the error. Since g6k needs beta>=40 (sieve) and the SD-BKZ DSD-onset gap is a beta=20 phenomenon, the regimes do not overlap; the cross-engine gap confirmation is likely not achievable as framed.
